Definition: Jizrachjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Izrahiah or Jezrahiah = "Jehovah will shine"; 1) a chieftain of Issachar; 2) a Levite and leader of the chorus at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
